_meta.note: Summary page and the strings the weekly digest shares with it.

oversight.title: Summary

completion.title: Course completion
completion.about: A course is counted once its last dose date has passed. It is complete when the clinic marked it complete. Courses still running are left out.

oversight.basisRate: {done} of {ended} courses whose last dose date has passed were marked complete by the clinic. {still} still running are left out.
oversight.basisFew: n = {n} of {min} needed: too few courses have reached their last dose date for a completion rate.
oversight.basisNone: No course has reached its last dose date yet.
oversight.noRegister: No register total is held to compare with.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.about: The notch is a stand-in. It shows what patients saw on the dog that bit them, not how many street dogs are sterilised.

areas.title: Areas
areas.about: Analysis areas: groups of neighbouring wards made for this study. They are not Jammu Municipal Corporation zones.

oversight.bounds: If every could-not-see answer had gone one way, the share would lie between {lo}% and {hi}%.

empty.title: Nothing recorded in this window yet
empty.body: Figures appear once courses are enrolled and patients answer calls.
